title: Molecular crosstalk between PPARγ and AhR determines the endocrine-disrupting profile of amiodarone (AMD) in hippocampal neurons.
mechanism: PPAR-gamma and AhR crosstalk regulates CYP1B1 expression
key_finding: PPAR-gamma and AhR molecular interaction determines amiodarone's endocrine-disrupting effects via CYP1B1 modulation in neurons.

title: Integrated Bioinformatics and Experimental Validation Reveal Fuzheng Yi'ai Formula Induces Immunogenic Cell Death Via the PERK-eIF2α-ATF4 Pathway for Prostate Cancer Treatment.
mechanism: PERK-eIF2α-ATF4 pathway activation induces immunogenic cell death
key_finding: Fuzheng Yi'ai formula induces immunogenic cell death in prostate cancer via PERK-eIF2α-ATF4 pathway.

title: ZSTK3744, a Novel Aryl Hydrocarbon Receptor Agonist, Exhibits Efficacy against Chemotherapy-Resistant Triple-Negative Breast Cancer.
mechanism: AhR agonist reduces chemotherapy resistance in TNBC
key_finding: ZSTK3744, an AhR agonist, overcomes chemotherapy resistance in triple-negative breast cancer.

title: Discovery of 2-phenylethyl chromones as potent and selective CYP1B1 inhibitors.
key_finding: 2-phenylethyl chromones identified as potent and selective CYP1B1 inhibitors.

title: Conformation of CD40LG and ANXA5 as Key Events of 2,7-Dibromocarbazole-Induced Cardiotoxicity Using in Vivo and in Vitro Models.
mechanism: CD40LG and ANXA5 conformational changes mediating cardiotoxicity
key_finding: 2,7-Dibromocarbazole induces cardiotoxicity via CD40LG and ANXA5 conformational alterations in vivo and in vitro.

title: Concentrated Angelica sinensis pills ameliorate ovarian insufficiency by promoting vascular remodeling via inhibiting CYP1B1/ACSL4-mediated ferroptosis.
key_finding: Angelica sinensis pills improve ovarian insufficiency by inhibiting CYP1B1/ACSL4-mediated ferroptosis to promote vascular remodeling.
